· 52-week position (12.8%) + Approaching the 52-week low($55,149.57) range.

[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.61): Subdued compared to the 5-day average, reducing the reliability of price movements.
· Current Stage Diagnosis (Accumulation): Maintaining a wait-and-see approach due to delayed RSI oversold exit and lack of trend formation in ADX.
